newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber little changed at noon.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber little changed at noon.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were little changed at noon with lack of big participation from consumers and a fall in Tokyo prices this morning pushing SMR grade down marginally, dealers said.

"Today is Monday and we have not seen any enquiries from any consumers yet," a dealer at a trading house said, adding that he expected the market to stay soft in line with weaker Tokyo and Indonesian markets.
Dealers said the lack of activity could be due to producers' reluctance to sell due to wintering period which may lead to supply tightness.
The market is expecting some inquiries from Asian and European users for nearby sheet and latex grades this week, dealers said.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 353 cents a kg, SMR L at 333, SMR 10 at 287 and drum latex at 230.
At midday, April RSS1 buyer was unchanged at 300 cents ($1.20) a kg and April SMR 20 buyers was down a cent at 285.50.
